candidate.name: Jordan Chen
candidate.headline: AI Product and Global Growth Lead

positions.title: Co-founder / AI Product Manager
bullets: Defined prompt standards, agent boundaries, interaction logic, and product prototypes for an AI education product.
Combined user research with C-end product iteration and B-end partnerships with language-learning institutions.
Improved generated-content accuracy and professionalism through prompt optimization and backend knowledge-data iteration.
positions.ownership: Owned product framing, prompt quality, agent workflow design, user research, and partner discovery.
positions.methods: Prompt evaluation, agent workflow design, user interviews, prototype testing, knowledge-data iteration, and market research.

positions.title: Head of Overseas Operations
bullets: Built three ecosystem brands from zero across DeFi, infrastructure, and ZKP hardware acceleration, then led go-to-market, SEO, and SEM programs that supported more than 20 million USD in annual revenue.
Activated X, Discord, and Telegram communities through ambassador programs and growth experiments, doubling monthly attention.
Represented projects at global blockchain conferences, led English roundtables and demos, and developed partner relationships.
Led a multimodal AI research group, evaluated leading models, tuned prompts, and built custom agents and AI workflows for team productivity.
positions.ownership: Owned overseas growth, marketing operations, community systems, conference partnerships, and an internal AI enablement workstream.
positions.methods: Go-to-market planning, SEO and SEM, Google Analytics, community operations, ambassador programs, event strategy, and prompt engineering.

positions.title: North America Business Lead
bullets: Advised international-school and North America admissions clients with individualized education plans.
Built trust and conversion through phone, WeChat, events, referral programs, and multi-channel follow-up.
Planned online and offline activities, brand content, media promotion, and audience research for the North America business.
positions.ownership: Owned client consulting, channel development, event programs, and business-facing brand operations.
positions.methods: Needs discovery, consultative sales, event marketing, referral growth, audience profiling, and content planning.

projects.name: Language AI Evaluation
projects.description: Designed an AI writing-scoring report with constrained generation and a concise feedback flow.

Coordinated frontend, backend, design, motion, and testing feedback.

projects.name: Anonymous DeFi Protocol

highlights: Reached more than 500,000 USD TVL within ten days of launch.
Created the milestone plan, documentation, X and Discord presence, partner motion, and multisig-holder election.
Elected six international governance representatives from a community spanning the United States, Mexico, Poland, and Japan.

projects.name: Privacy Bridge Growth

highlights: Grew organic X followers by more than 20,000 in one month, exceeded 420,000 test-period wallet addresses, and supported more than 30,000 Discord members.
Won a first-place ecosystem incentive, secured a development grant, and won an infrastructure track at a major Ethereum hackathon.

projects.name: ZK Acceleration Platform
projects.description: Built market-facing operations for a ZKP algorithm and hardware acceleration platform.
highlights: Created a bilingual technical content channel and overseas customer community.
Established technical collaboration with global ZKP semiconductor partners and helped move market share toward 18%.

projects.name: Global Developer Community

highlights: Used Google Analytics to guide product and content improvements; quarterly X attention doubled.
Hosted English community sessions with an average of more than 1,500 listeners and coordinated a two-day conference with more than 4,000 attendees.
